**વાળા સમાજ — Mahuva Vala Rajput Samaj community directory, official release.**

- **MVPMI-v….apk** (same file as **mvpmi.apk**) — install on Android phones (Android 10 or newer); share the link https://samaj.kavigsv.com/download.
- **mvpmi-play.aab** — for Google Play Console (Production → Create new release).
- **BUILD-INFO.txt** (version, build) and **SHA256SUMS.txt** (checksums).

Signed with the community's permanent key: every later release installs over this one and members stay logged in. Phones that had a test (alpha) build must uninstall it once before installing; the directory data on the server is not affected.

New in 1.4.0:
- Greetings from the Main Admin with an optional picture, in the Message Centre (Like, Save; the Main Admin sees who saw and liked; edit or remove).
- Profile pictures with a crop/zoom editor; village-wise member PDF; Bhadrod added, Zinzaka (Rajula, Amreli) corrected.
- Main Admin can add members directly and re-allow or correct rejected/removed numbers.
- A second phone using the same number needs a 6-digit code shown on the first phone.
- New bottom bar (Home in the centre; Dark and Language at the top).
- The app updates itself: a forced update page, background download and notifications. The app is now about 3 MB.

Tested: server tests, the full browser checklist, and Android emulator tests on Android 10, 13 and 16 — all passing.
